# Intro

What would happen in CFI if we cut in 1990 at 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100%?
(according to FVS)

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(targets)
  library(tarchetypes)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(terra)
  library(tidyterra)
  library(sf)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(measurements)
  library(mlr3verse) # Machine Learning in R framework, larger universe
  library(ggspatial) # annotation_scale, annotation_north_arrow
  library(ggfx) # for fancy ggplot stuff like with_blur
  library(patchwork) # for n-up ggplot
})
tar_source()
```

Preload targets results

```{r, eval = FALSE}
tar_load(fiadb)
tar_load(species_crosswalk)
tar_load(fvs_num_partitions)
tar_load(fvs_partition)
tar_load(fvs_randseed)
tar_load(fvsne_states)
tar_load(cfigro_bai_model)
tar_load(cfigro_estab)
tar_load(cfigro_none_growth)
tar_load(cfigro_plot)

mgmt_ids <- c("DFLT")
for (mgmt_id in mgmt_ids) {
  f = list.files(pattern = paste0("*_CFICOP_", mgmt_id, ".Rmd"))
  normalizePath(f) |>
    tar_objects_defined_in_rmd() |>
    tar_load()
}
```

# Harvest

Given plots and CUTEFF, harvest all plots at that efficiency.

```{r}
cfialt_harvest <- function(plots, cuteff) {
  plots |>
    select(STAND_CN) |>
    mutate(
      YEAR = 1990,
      DBH_MIN = 5,
      DBH_MAX = 999,
      PERCENT = cuteff,
      SPCD = 0, # All species
      TPA = 0, # ignored
      BA = 0 # ignored
    ) |>
  # Arrange this for humans to be able to digest
  arrange(YEAR, SPCD, DBH_MIN)
}
```

# Run FVS

```{r}
timestep <- 10 # years; determined by FVSne variant
fvsbin_dir <- "~/bin"  # TODO: put these in a config file
fvs_variant <- "FVSne" # TODO: put these in a config file
data_dir <- "data/fvs"
title <- "CFIALT"

for (cuteff in c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) {
  mgmt_id <- sprintf("H%03d", round(cuteff * 100))
  print(mgmt_id)
  project_dir <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("FVS_", title, "_", mgmt_id))
  if (!dir.exists(project_dir)) {
    dir.create(project_dir)
  }
  
  fvs_run(
    fvsbin_dir = fvsbin_dir,
    fvs_variant = fvs_variant,
    project_dir = project_dir,
    fiadb = NULL,
    title = title,
    mgmt_id = mgmt_id,
    stands = cfigro_plot,
    trees = cficop_dflt_trees,
    regen = cficop_dflt_estab,
    harvest = cfialt_harvest(cfigro_plot, cuteff)
  )
}
```

# Results

```{r}
data_dir <- "data/fvs"
title <- "CFIALT"
cfialt_carbon <- lapply(c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), \(cuteff) {
  mgmt_id <- sprintf("H%03d", round(cuteff * 100))
  file_basename <- paste0("FVS_", title, "_", mgmt_id)
  fvs_output_db <- file.path(
    data_dir, 
    file_basename,
    paste0(file_basename, "_Output.db")
  )
  tibble(output_db = fvs_output_db) |>
    fvs_read_output("FVS_Carbon") |>
    mutate(cuteff = !!cuteff)
}) |>
  do.call(bind_rows, args = _)
```

```{r}
cfialt_carbon |>
  group_by(Year, cuteff) |>
  summarise(value = mean(Aboveground_Total_Live), .groups = "drop") |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(name = ordered(
    paste0(round(cuteff * 100), "%"),
    levels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%")
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(Year, value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("CFI Modeled Harvest by Intensity") +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab(bquote("Aboveground Live Carbon" ~ (`Mg C` ~ ha^-1))) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Harvest Intensity")
```
## Delta

```{r cfi_carbon_delta}
cfialt_carbon |>
  group_by(StandID, cuteff) |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  mutate(delta = (Aboveground_Total_Live - lag(Aboveground_Total_Live))/10) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(delta)) |>
  mutate(
    name = ordered(
      paste0(round(cuteff * 100), "%"),
      levels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%")
    ),
    group = interaction(Year, name, lex.order = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(Year != 1990) |>
  ggplot(aes(Year, delta, fill = name, group = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.1) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("CFI Modeled Carbon Delta by Harvest Intensity") +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab(bquote("Aboveground Live Carbon Delta" ~ (`Mg C` ~ ha^-1 ~ yr^-1))) +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Harvest Intensity")
```
